articleTitle: Keynote Speakers [4 abstracts]
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Provides an abstract for each of the keynote presentations and may include a brief professional biography of each presenter. The complete presentations were not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: Research on Reference Target Detection of Deep Learning Framework Faster-RCNN
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development and progress of computer-related facilities and equipment, deep learning has been widely used in computer fields such as image classification and target detection. Many researchers have proposed a new learning objective -- detection algorithm on the basis of traditional computer research. In this paper, by comparing the target detection algorithm with the traditional manual feature extraction and feature design algorithm, it can be found that the convolutional neural network algorithm has good effects in feature expression ability, semantic expression ability, robustness and other aspects. The deep learning target detection algorithms mainly involved in this paper include R-CNN, Fast-RCNN, Faster-RCNN, YOLO and SSD. The research mainly considers the detection speed and the sensitivity of small target detection comprehensively, and realizes apple detection under natural light through improving the based model of Faster-RCNN.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Text Matching: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Text matching is one of the crucial technology in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP), and it has been applied in many tasks, such as textual similarity, information retrieval and question answering. The target of text matching is to model the relationship between two input texts. In this paper, we aim to give a survey on recent advance techniques of deep-learning based text matching methods. Specifically, depending on whether a model will first encode a sentence into a fixed-length vector without any incorporating from the other sentence, the existing studies can be categorized into two major categories: representation-based models and interaction-based models. The latter can be divided into two groups according to the interaction methods. In addition, we summarize the strengths and weaknesses of these methods to help beginners in this area to choose the appropriate model for their application. Finally, we make a conclusion by highlighting several directions and open problems which need to be further explored by the community in the future.

articleTitle: On the Application of Calligraphy Art in Digital Film and Television Works
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Calligraphy, as a classic of Chinese traditional culture, has been widely used in digital film and television works. It will be the future development track of Chinese film and television culture to adhere to the edification of traditional art and calligraphy aesthetics and set up the digital film and television art subject with national characteristics. Taking the innovation of calligraphy culture in the film and television art as the basis, and starting from the specific applications such as cognitions, forms and techniques, this paper explores how the digital film and television works return to the national traditional culture. It aims to make the visual art, cultural connotation and aesthetic spirit of calligraphy fully displayed in the film and television works, and thus to realize the perfect fusion between traditional digital film and television art and international culture.

articleTitle: Analyses of Current Status of Domestic Research on Virtual Reality Technology in Education
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The investment and application of Virtual Reality on education makes new requirement for the construction of institutions of higher learning’s experiment platform as well as teaching reform as Virtual Reality is being an emerging research orientation in institutions of higher learning. Based on the statistics on the core literaturess included in CNKI from 2000 to 2019, the paper explores the current research status of Virtual Reality in education in China from three aspects: the amount of annual publications, the discipline research field, and the fund support, pointing out the existing problems in the research of Virtual Reality in education, which are the formulation of development plan, the construction of sharing platform, the integration and application of Virtual Reality and specialty as well as the investment in key fields.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of China’s Stock Market Volatility Based on Markov Switching GARCH Model
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper introduces the Markov switching GARCH (MS-GARCH) model by GARCH family model to conduct an empirical research on the adverse effects of repeated violent fluctuations in China's stock prices due to the increasingly obvious economic impacts between countries. The empirical results show that, comparing to the traditional GARCH family model, the MS-GARCH model considers the endogenous transfer mechanism of stock market volatility, which fits the volatility of Chinese stock market more accurately and is better than the GARCH family model.

articleTitle: Analysis of Multi-factor Stock Market Choice Portfolio Model Based on Regression
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Under the background of the comprehensive promotion of the concept of quantitative investment, the corresponding investment has also received the attention of the domestic society from all walks of life, and has been widely used in the market environment. Therefore, while understanding the basic theory of the multi-factor stock selection model, this paper analyzes how to construct the multi-factor stock selection portfolio model based on the regression method according to the classification of capital asset pricing, arbitrage pricing and stock selection model.

articleTitle: Impact of Big Data Analytic Capability on Firm Performance: The Moderating Effect of IT-Strategic Alignment
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the popularization of big data application and services, human being is stepping into the big data era. More and more people believe that big data capability will become the core competitiveness of enterprises in the future, it is becoming more and more important to focus on the firm big data analysis capabilities and its impacts. Focused on middle and high-level employees of enterprises using big data analysis capability, this research analyzed the relationship of big data analysis capability and firm performance, mediated by sensing, seizing and reconfiguring. Besides, the article discussed the moderating effect of IT-strategic alignment. As for the research methods, this research collected data from 210 middle and high level employees of enterprises, and concluded that:(1) Big data analysis ability has a positive impact on firm performance by influencing sensing, seizing and reconfiguring, and the different contributions of different dimensions of dynamic capabilities to the overall mediating effect.(2) IT- strategic alignment positively moderates the relationship between big data analysis ability and sensing/ seizing/ reconfiguring.

articleTitle: A User Behavior Analysis Method Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the developing progress of the Internet and the pandemic deterioration, more people decide to shop online. The online eCommerce business is quickly expanding. Understanding users’ purchase behavior is a key component to growing sales and improving the website’s design and flow. We use User Behavior Data from Tianchi of Alibaba Cloud. The data were randomly selected about one million users who have behaviors of page view, purchase, shopping to cart, and adding to favorite during November 25 to December 27, 2017. There are a total of ten million records. We used four dimensions to approach this problem: time, item, conversion rate from Funnel Analysis, and valuable customers from RFM Model. From the time dimension, users are more likely to visit pages during the weekends from 10 am to 3 pm. From the item dimension, the top ten items were purchased over one hundred times during this time frame. The number is outstanding back in 2017. For the conversion rate from Funnel Analysis, adding items into the cart has a higher conversion rate compared to marking items as favorites. For the customer dimension, we used an RFM (recency, frequency, monetary) model to identify valuable users. We can advise Taobao to improve the favorite item remainder process, increase the exposure of hot selling items during peak hours and week of the day, and offer more promotions/recommendations to valuable customers.

articleTitle: Research on Spatial Big Data Management and High Performance Computing Based on Information Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the new era, with the development of urban construction and the improvement of social and economic level, in the face of increasing information requirements, the computer technology used in the past has been unable to meet the current market demand. Therefore, on the basis of understanding the technical research background, this paper analyzes the characteristics and key technologies of spatial big data management on the information cloud platform, and deeply discusses the contents of high-performance computing on the information cloud platform.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of University Intelligent Laboratory Based on Big Data Background
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the continuous development of big data in modern education informatization, the content of teaching experiments has become more and more abundant, the types of laboratory equipment have become more diversified, and the overall experiment content is more comprehensive and practical. University laboratory as a key place of university education, because of its more and more high functional requirements for the laboratory construction requirements to standardize, intelligence, information, open, sharing the direction forward. Because of the increase of experimental projects and experimental instruments, the management of laboratories has become cumbersome. The management of modern laboratories is not applicable to the traditional form of manual management. The management of laboratories is also increasingly information-based and intelligent. Based on the research and analysis of laboratory construction and management at home and abroad, this paper designs open intelligent laboratory management measures combined with big data technology, and uses the Internet of Things and big data technology to build a laboratory management system. Building a wireless sensor network for laboratory environmental information collection, the intelligent control and support management of the laboratory can be shown through the intelligent terminal equipment, including access control card, intelligent lighting regulation, temperature and humidity detection, feedback equipment information management and so on. The data mining and analysis of the laboratory is realized by collecting the digital information of the laboratory, which provides decision support for the intelligent management of the laboratory.

articleTitle: Research on Travel Personalized Recommendation Information Retrieval Based on Big Data Improvement Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Tourism, as a basic component of social and economic development and urban construction, is also the core content to meet the spiritual needs of residents. Therefore, on the basis of understanding the current integrated development form of the Internet and tourism, this paper analyzes how to build a recommendation information retrieval model with personalized tourism based on the Apriori algorithm, aiming at the improved algorithm proposed based on big data.

articleTitle: Review and analysis of data mining in the field of education in China-Scientific metrological analysis based on CNKI (2010-2020)
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: As the specific application of data mining in the field of education, educational data mining and learning analysis can better promote the development of education in China by studying the hot spots and existing problems in the field of education. In order to comprehensively analyze the research and development status of data mining in the field of education, this paper takes the relevant research papers in THE CNKI database from 2010 to 2020 as the data source, and applies the method of scientometrics to carry out the research from three dimensions: author, key words, region and institution. The research shows that learning analysis, data mining and big data have always been the research hotspots in the field of education, and the research scale and maturity are gradually increasing. At the same time, the research of educational data mining and learning analysis has a tendency to focus on practical application instead of theory. In addition, this paper also analyzes the algorithms in the research paper, and introduces the practical application of the algorithms in the field of education. Based on the analysis in this paper, algorithm is also a hot research topic in the future, the innovation of teaching reform and the improvement of teaching quality are always the goal of struggle.

articleTitle: The Value, Foundation and Direction of Marketing Innovation Research in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: At present, big data has been destined from the concept. There is a large number of applications in precision marketing, smart medical, film and television entertainment, finance, education, sports, and security. With the rapid development of cloud computing, Internet of Things, mobile Internet and other supporting industries, big data will have a broader application market space in the future. One of the key contents of research in the current era is the specific application of big data technology, and the application of big data technology in marketing management is also in the scope of its research. Application data technology processing work has the characteristics of fast and convenient. Therefore, we need to focus on studying how to fully apply big data technology in marketing management to improve the level of innovation in marketing management. According to the characteristics of big data technology and the marketing management process, it is fully integrated to improve the marketing efficiency and level.

articleTitle: Target Tracking Research Hotspots and Frontier Trends Based on Citespace
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the continuous development of artificial intelligence technology, target tracking is a hot problem in the field of computer vision, which has a wide range of application prospects in industrial, military, transportation, medical and other fields. In this paper, Citespace software is used to conduct descriptive statistical analysis and knowledge mapping analysis of target tracking based on domestic CNKI database literature, and to explore the development status and frontier trends in the field of target tracking in China. On this basis, point out three shortcomings of current research: low accuracy of target tracking in complex environments, poor real-time target tracking, and few application directions, and give suggestions to improve algorithm robustness, real-time, accelerate engineering implementation, and focus on future research trends.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Enterprise Value Management under the Network Economy Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the coming of network economy, under the mechanism of market becoming global competition, the development mode of enterprises should be reformed and restructured according to the requirements of network economic environment. Merger and reorganization become an effective means to improve the competitiveness of enterprises. The network economic environment makes the value chain model evolve to the network model, and the enterprise reengineering based on value management becomes the inevitable need of enterprise development. From the perspective of value management, this paper studies business process reengineering deeply, which provides methods and means for resource integration of large enterprise groups after reengineering.

articleTitle: Joint Analysis of Stock Price Predictive Models Using Past Stock Values and Public Sentiments on Twitter
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In this study, attempts have been made to predict the stock price movement base on the company Western Digital Corporation. Daily stock price data is used for training and building the predictive models. Four machine learning and deep learning analysis including but not limited to linear regression and ARIMA are built and compared to select the appropriate model with highest accuracy using past stock price as training set. Besides, Twitter data has been considered to provide another angle of analysis that focus on public’s sentiment. Four Classifying models are used to value the sentiment of tweet contents separately. Extensive discussions have been presented on the performance of these models with critical evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on the Innovation Mode of Scientific Research Service of University Library Based on the Operation Mode of Question-and-answer Community
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The university library is one of the important organizations of the school and the external expression of the school culture. Library is the main position of school education and teaching, it not only can perfect and improve the student’s professional knowledge, it can also perfect the student’s personality, to the student’s ideological and political education, to cultivate a socialist qualified builder has an important role. In the context of the Internet, the application model of the question-and-answer community has developed rapidly .With the help of the question-and-answer community, users can fully express their views and ideas, promote the exchange and sharing of information and knowledge. At the same time, the operating mode of the question-and-answer community also provides a new way of thinking for the innovation of scientific research services in academic libraries. Based on the question-and-answer community operation model, this article analyzes the relevant content of the scientific research service innovation model of university libraries.

articleTitle: A Robust Segmentation Method for Chinese Inscription Images
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Inscriptions are important carriers of Chinese calligraphy which has high calligraphic, artistic and cultural value. Segmentation of Chinese inscription images play a fundamental role in processing of Chinese character images. Traditional projection segmentation methods can be used for Chinese inscription image segmentation because Chinese characters in most inscription images arrange regularly. However, in an actual segmentation process, the slight offset of the glyph position or a crossing of strokes after projection caused projection segmentation method failure. In order to solve this problem, a Chinese inscription image segmentation method based on clustering algorithm was provided. Firstly, preprocessed the image, and then looked up the contour of the inscription images to exclude the obvious abnormal part of the contour size; Secondly, filled in the remaining contours to obtain a clustered sample set; Thirdly, used the DBSCAN clustering algorithm to cluster the sample set to generate several clusters which each of those clusters represented a Chinese character image; Finally, for clusters that did not satisfy the outline range of Chinese characters, adjusted the minimum neighborhood until the aspect ratio of the circumscribed rectangle of the cluster was within the range of the aspect ratio of Chinese characters. We conducted character segmentation experiments on sample inscriptions. Results showed that out method not only segmented and processed the regularly arranged inscriptions images, but also worked efficiently for irregularly arranged inscriptions images.

articleTitle: Study on the Connection Between the Specialty Setting of Private Colleges and Regional Economy -- A Case Study of a College in Guangdong Province
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Private higher education is a very important part of higher education. Taking a college in Guangdong province as an example, this paper analyzes the problems existing in the connection between private undergraduate colleges and regional social and economic development: weak service consciousness, weak foundation for running schools, limited funds, lag in specialty setting and many other factors. The specialty setting and layout of a college in Guangdong are not forward-looking, and it does not fully consider the development of strategic emerging industries in Dongguan, and lacks important human resources support, thus affecting the realization of the local economic development strategy.

articleTitle: Establishment and Application of Multi-level Control Mechanism for Key Quality Node of Co-production Volume Package Based on Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Under the existing tobacco monopoly system, due to the existence of the index of "cigarette plan", each tobacco industry enterprises in the actual business process, will encounter the problem of "there is no brand plan or no market plan". Under the environment of prominent macroeconomic downward pressure, increasing fiscal and taxation pressure, industrial production and sales scale, total tax and profit and other economic indicators have been at a high level, cooperative production is gradually facing stage problems such as "increasing development pressure, brand development stock segmentation, cooperation enthusiasm is not high". Under the background of the construction of modern tobacco economic system by the National Bureau and the comprehensive implementation of lean management, Zhejiang China Tobacco is committed to studying how to optimize the cooperative production process, improve efficiency, and make the cooperative production supply chain more adapt to the rapidly changing market demand. Study how to achieve mutual benefit and win-win situation of both parties in cooperation, and coordinate development in the improvement of product quality and the optimization of control level of partners. Through long-term continuous quality improvement activities, the quality control level of the cooperative production process has been improved in an orderly way.

articleTitle: A Study On Personal Information Protection Mechanism Of Web Platform In Big Data Age
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of network technology, people communicate more and more frequently on the Web platform. Especially in the trend of economic globalization, the world has gradually entered the era of big data. When people search for information on the Web platform, they will also leak their privacy. At this time, criminals will take the opportunity to use false information to infringe others' rights and interests. Therefore, on the basis of understanding the content of personal information protection in the era of big data, this paper analyzes how to build the corresponding protection mechanism for personal information according to various algorithms of data mining on the current Web platform.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the Relationship between Regional Logistics Development and Economic Growth
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Along with the social division of labor refinement, under the process of global economic development, because of the advanced management thought and form of organization, logistics was applied in regional economic development, including the effect of stress on the development of regional economic integration, widespread concern from all walks of life, important research direction of regional economy gradually into the relationship between logistics and regional economic growth. In this paper, according to the regional logistics in our country economic development theory and the international logistics under the support of economic theory, with real GDP index to measure the Yangtze river between silk road economic belt and the surrounding areas in major provinces and cities logistics technical index of economic development, regional economic development and logistics technology level of two indicators to measure the qualitative relationship analysis, USES the international cargo logistics turnover function to measure, mainly using logistic function using the quantitative analysis model of measure of the relationship between the two.

articleTitle: The Impact of High Technology on The Economy
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Nowadays, the world economic development has entered into a new historical stage which is called the knowledge economy era. In this era, high technology industries have become the first pillar of economic growth. Some people generally think of this competition of the contemporary international society is considered to be the comprehensive national strength and science and technology competition. In fact, the high technology industry has become the focus of today’s international competition and the strategic commanding heights that major nations are pursuing. Based on the analysis of the related conceptions in high technology, this article analyses the relationship between high technology and economy. Learning historical experience through applied empirical. Most importantly, in order to have a further analysis of the effect of high technology on the economy, the high technology data has been analysed. Through data, we can understand the impact of technology on economy more intuitively.

Author Keywords: high technology data. Field of Science and Technology
as required by OECD: Social sciences

articleTitle: Evaluation and Forecast of Port Enterprise Innovation Efficiency Based on ES-DEA
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the current deep development of global trade, there are new requirements for port technology innovation and management innovation. The article combines the exponential smoothing method with the DEA model, which analyzes the innovation efficiency of SIPG in the next five years to find out the business strategy. It is concluded that the innovation efficiency of SIPG will maintain a relatively high level from 2011 to 2024. The average comprehensive innovation efficiency reached 0.92, and the comprehensive innovation efficiency reached the DEA effective in 2011, 2012, 2015 in the historical years. In the forecast year, 2020-2023 is not effective, and output is insufficient .In the next few years, SIPG should further increase research investment and reserves of scientific and technical personnel to improve the port's comprehensive innovation efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on Supply Chain Pricing Strategy of Government-Subsidized Manufacturers
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: From the perspective of the coexistence of new energy vehicles and fuel vehicles, a dynamic game model composed of the manufacturer, retailer and government were built, and the optimal pricing strategy was worked out by considering the supply chain pricing strategy under the Stackelberg game modeled by the manufacturer. The research shows that the government subsidy must be controlled within a reasonable range to stimulate the enthusiasm of manufacturers; The R&D cost coefficient is inversely proportional to the greenness of new energy vehicles, and consumers' green preference is directly proportional to it. The level of the R&D cost coefficient directly affects the manufacturer's production choice. Consumer preference for green and R&D input cost coefficient for new energy vehicle pricing is proportional to the impact.

articleTitle: Research on the Effective Transformation Path of Chinese IT Enterprises in the Internet + Era
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The growth rate of information flow is very fast, and it is not changed by people's will. When the flow is increasing, it is mainly to see who has the ability to solve and dredge these flows. No enterprise can guarantee that it will not be surpassed by other enterprises in the future. In the Internet + era, China's IT enterprises should try their best to keep their employees vigour and maintain the ability to compete with new companies. This article mainly discusses the effective transformation path of China's IT enterprises in Internet + era to keep pace with the times and forge ahead.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Source Correlation Technology and Economic Analysis Technology Based on New Digital Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Under the dual carbon goal, the power grid company actively promotes the implementation of the "digital transformation" strategy, and improves the power grid resource allocation, intelligent interaction and service support capacity by fully implementing the digital enabling project. Facing the requirements of double carbon, carry out the research on the future power grid form and build the power digitization technology system. Based on digital architecture and other technologies, this paper studies the technical and economic analysis and evaluation technology of digital economic benefits of power grid enterprises for multiple application scenarios. Aiming at the business demand scenarios such as power grid basic resource operation, power data value-added service and digital platform ecological construction, this paper studies the power grid digital architecture technology, constructs the technical and economic evaluation model for power grid digital system, studies the intelligent classification of data based on differential cluster analysis and decision-making technology based on support vector machine, and realizes the intelligent rating of the project. This paper focuses on multi-source related technical and economic analysis based on new digital technology, solves the practical problems of benefit quantitative evaluation in the process of digital transformation and construction of power grid companies, and can well guide the follow-up digital construction work of power grid companies.

articleTitle: On the Use of M00201 Peristaltic Pump in Infusion Configuration of Pharmacy Intravenous Admixture Services Based on the Hospital Information System
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Objective: This project is to explore the application value of M00201 peristaltic pump in the infusion configuration of pharmacy intravenous admixture services (PIVAS). Methods: In the PIVAS infusion configuration, the disposable sterile empty needle was used as the control group, and the peristaltic pump was used as the experimental group. Results: The average preparation time of Aidi Injection, Marsdenia Tenacissima Injection, Cervus and Cucumis Polypeptide Injection, Kangai Injection, Levofloxacin Injection, Imipenem and Cilastatin for Injection in the experimental group was 34.21s±, 42.62s±, 13.68s±, 21.82s±, 24.11s±, 21.01s±, which was significantly less than that in the control group (73.62s±, 73.81s±, 24.08s±, 35.02s±, 49.17s±, 27.73s±). Compare different configuration methods before and after using peristaltic pump for 6 kinds of drugs, and there was a significant difference in the time required to complete the infusion preparation (P<0.05). Conclusion: The application of the peristaltic pump in the infusion configuration is easy to operate and can shorten the configuration time, which can effectively improve the efficiency of the intravenous drug configuration, ensure the safety of the clinical medication and improve the quality of the pharmaceutical care. With the assistance of Hospital Information System (HIS), this experiment classifies and records the problems existing in the traditional infusion configuration. This system then summarizes, contrasts and analyzes the experimental data, putting forward and implementing improvement measures accordingly. And the value in using the device in infusion configuration can be discussed thereby.

articleTitle: The Role and Application of Big Data Technology in Decision-Making Management of Colleges And Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: with the advent of the era of big data, people’s way of thinking and habits have changed greatly. In Colleges and universities, big data has the characteristics of massive, high growth and diversity. Colleges and universities should seize the opportunity to tap the value of campus big data. Data driven self-development, from the ideological and political education, teaching quality, advantageous disciplines, social services, scientific research achievements and international influence and other aspects of data collection, extraction, cleaning, association analysis and mining, construction of university data "one table" project; and on this basis, build big data auxiliary system to assist managers in administrative decision-making, in order to promote the comprehensive construction of universities It brings new ideas for the management of colleges and universities in the new era.

articleTitle: Research on Industrial Design Innovation Method Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Under the background of economic globalization, industrial design has gradually been integrated into daily life and work, prompting all walks of life to pay close attention to the innovation and development of industrial design. Therefore, on the basis of understanding the definition of industrial design and data mining, this paper analyzes how to analyze innovative industrial technology based on data mining according to the current market development trend.

articleTitle: The Reconstruction and Motion Capture of Human Three Dimesion Based on Viedo Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: the development of digital media technology, animation, game and movie industry demand and requirement of motion capture technology is more and more high, but for now to buy commercial motion capture system cost is too high, the requirement of using the environment is too strict, need on the performer's special facilities, such as installation of marked points to operate, high difficulty. Therefore, based on the understanding of computer vision and graphics related technology, this paper analyzes the human 3D reconstruction and motion capture technology, and its future development is deeply discussed.

articleTitle: A Study on Prediction Model of BP Algorithm in Macroeconomics
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Under the guidance of economic theory, the macroeconomic system is deeply studied. Clarify the characteristics of the macroeconomic system and discuss the macro-economic pointer system. According to the complexity and openness of macro-economic system, qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis are combined to analyze macro-economy by the method of comprehensive integration. To study the conventional methods of quantitative prediction; Using artificial neural network technology, under the connection of polynomial fitting and BP neural network, the prediction model system is created, and the prediction model is modeled by this way, which greatly improves the prediction accuracy of the system. It is found that the macro economy under BP algorithm shows an upward trend of development.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Cosmetics Purchasing Intention of Traditional Chinese Cosmetics Customers
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the continuous development of China's economy, consumers' demand for daily cosmetics is increasing day by day. Faced with such a strong demand for cosmetics, cosmetics companies must think about how to improve consumer perception of the value of their cosmetics. And increase the market share of the brand. Based on existing research results, this paper analyzes customers' purchasing tendency from the perspective of consumers' perceived value through a questionnaire survey, studies the mediating role of brand identity between perceived value and consumers' purchasing intention, and compares and analyzes the purchasing behavior of traditional Chinese cosmetics customers to domestic cosmetics under the effect of group consensus regulation. SPSS25.0 and AMOS24.0 software were used to analyze the data to study the relationship between perceived value and brand identity of traditional Chinese cosmetics customers and their buying behavior, and the moderating effect of group conformance factors was also analyzed. The results show that the group consensus has a significant moderating effect on the relationship between domestic cosmetics brand identity and consumers' purchase intention.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Distributed Cloud Monitoring Big Data Storage Based on Zabbix
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, cloud monitoring has become a new form of service provided by cloud service providers for consumers. The cloud monitoring technology can not only show the content that users are interested in to consumers in the form of strong readability, but also directly warn them in the case of abnormal. Therefore, on the basis of understanding the advantages of Zabbix technology, this paper studies the platform design of distributed cloud monitoring and the key technologies of big data storage, and carries out experimental verification and analysis on them.

articleTitle: Extraction and Analysis of Tennis Video Target Slow Motion
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Sport, as a healthy and fun form of activity, is practiced by different groups of people. In order to meet the audience's psychological needs, sports video directors will be wonderful shots in the form of slow motion, the scene reproduction. Slow motion contains rich semantic information, so the analysis of slow motion is of great value. In this article, using the existing identity transformation of tennis video as study material, clearly appear in the process of the detection threshold selection of situation, put forward the objective of slow motion tennis video adaptive threshold detection method, the slow motion of adaptive threshold selection problem is resolved, the accuracy and high boundary location accuracy slow motion video frames, this discovery also apply to other sports video in slow motion detection, finally summarized based on the background subtraction and remember a moving target extraction method based on background compensation.

articleTitle: Research on Video Expression Recognition Based on Migrated Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Face expression recognition is an important part of artificial intelligence research and development, and it is also one of the important technologies to ensure the human-computer friendly interaction to truly achieve the intelligent goal. After understanding the dynamic time warping and its improved algorithm, this paper analyzes how to design video facial expression recognition system based on 3D-CNN according to the construction and application of convolutional neural network.

articleTitle: Research on Credit Loan Risk Control of Big Data Platform Based on Long and Cycle Memory Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the rapid development of China's social economy, the credit loan market is also expanding, and with the improvement of scientific research and technology, the market has gradually emerged a large number of credit loan platform. At this time, in order to better protect the small and micro enterprises and individual businesses in the network credit loan platform to obtain the demand for funds, it is necessary to strengthen the practice and development of credit loan risk control research efforts. On the basis of understanding the neural network of long and short periodic memory and according to the characteristic way of obtaining credit data information on the big data platform, this paper builds a data set dimension combinatorial optimization model and studies the final experimental results accordingly.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Teaching Spatial Model Based on Cloud-side Data Co-operation
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the era of big data, the construction of intelligent teaching space model based on cloud edge data collaboration is the focus of current education innovation exploration. On the basis of understanding the construction model and based on the secure storage system of cloud edge data collaboration, this paper deeply discusses how to realize the technology and finally obtain the results.

articleTitle: Risk Measurement Portfolio Investment Model Supporting Process Integration and its Algebraic Solution
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the securities market full of risks and opportunities, when investing in securities, both individual and institutional investors always take the safety and liquidity of investment funds as the premise, and rationally use investment funds to achieve the purpose of lower risks and higher returns. Markowitz established a portfolio investment decision model with the variance of securities return rate as the measure of investment risks, and selected the optimal portfolio. This paper analyzes the shortcomings of Markowitz model based on supporting process integration, and puts forward the risk objective function of optimal portfolio selection based on semivariance (E-Sh) risk measure. By simplifying and analyzing the equation, under certain conditions, the nonlinear option pricing model is transformed into a linear equation type, and the specific time-dependent option pricing formula with transaction costs is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on the Function of Automatic Evaluation of English Grades Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the development of education innovation, the application of modern technology to evaluate and analyze students' English performance can not only save teachers' time, but also improve the accuracy of student achievement evaluation. Therefore, in the context of scientific and technological exploration and innovation, the automatic English score grading function based on data mining has become the main direction of current scientific research exploration. On the basis of understanding the relevant concepts of data mining in English scores, this paper analyzes how to apply it effectively in practice by studying the automatic evaluation model of English scores based on data mining.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Hologram in Long-distance Red Tour Education
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Red Education plays an important role in China’s ideological and political education. However, at present, there are some problems in Red Education, such as the crowded observation, lack of immersion in the online exhibition hall, and the weak sense of experience. Red Tourism is an important part of Red Education and plays an indispensable role therein. In the information age, it has become urgent to integrate holographic technology into Red Tour Education. Taking the campus of Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications (BUPT) as a pilot, this study designs a set of comprehensive, deeply immersive, and strongly interactive Red Education systems that enable students to understand red history more actively and improve their overall ideological and political levels.

articleTitle: Research on Similarity Search Technique of Variable Long Time Series Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Time series similarity search is the main subroutine of time series data mining algorithm. The efficiency of time series similarity research has become an obstacle to the development of time series mining algorithms. The representation of time series and the measurement of similarity are the basis of time series similarity research and play a crucial role in completing the similarity search task of time series. As a method of measuring similarity, the dynamic distortion of time can be effectively dealt with by deforming the time series over time, and it has good stability. However, time series data is usually an ever-increasing data stream, and the direct study of similarity will cause considerable storage space consumption, and may affect the accuracy and reliability of the algorithm. Therefore, it is necessary to determine the time series in advance, express the main self of the original time series in a concise and abstract form, and carry out similarity search on the developed sequence to improve the similarity search efficiency of the sequence.

articleTitle: Financial-Industrial Integration, Financing Constraints and Corporate R&D Investment
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Taking domestic A-share listed companies from 2007 to 2019 as research samples. This paper examines the relationship between financial-industrial integration, financing constraints and corporate R&D investment. The study found that the integration of industry and finance has significantly promoted R&D investment in enterprises, and financing constraints have shown a significant intermediary effect in financial-industrial integration and corporate R&D investment. Financial-industrial integration has remarkably promoted corporate R&D investment by reducing corporate financing constraints.

articleTitle: Research on China’s Industrial Structure Adjustment under the New Economic Normal
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper constructs a model of industrial structure upgrading and rationalization, and studies the process of industrial structure adjustment in China under the new economic normalising the data of 24 province,autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government(hereinafter referred to as 24 provinces) from 2014 to 2019. Finally, it is concluded that China's industrial structure has gradually become highly developed, but there are some problems among industrial structures: firstly, the proportion of three industrial structures is uncoordinated; secondly, the regional development of three industrial structures is unbalanced. Therefore, China should make use of domestic and foreign resources, go by technological innovation ,promote the upgrading and rationalization of industrial structure, and achieve high-quality economic development.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on The Impact of Venture Capital on Enterprise Technological Innovation
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Based on the current research on the impact of venture capital on enterprise technological innovation, the article explores the mechanism of venture capital to promote technological innovation by considering the characteristics of enterprise venture capital and the characteristics of enterprise technological innovation.Taking the currently listed companies on the Dongguan Growth Enterprise Market as a sample, the research on the correlation between current venture capital and the technological innovation of listed companies shows that from the perspective of enterprises, venture capital has relevance to corporate technological innovation.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Dynamic Relationship between Regional Energy Consumption and Economic Growth Based on Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Based on the co-integration analysis and causal relationship, this paper discusses the relationship between economic growth and energy consumption, and then combined with case analysis, puts forward effective measures for the future social and economic development and energy consumption.

articleTitle: Research on the New Crisis and Countermeasures of College Students' Interpersonal Relationship in the New Media Era
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Human relationship is a kind of social relationship established in the process of production and life activities, for college students, when the moment to enter the campus with teachers, students to carry out a variety of interpersonal communication, the formation of college students campus interpersonal relationship. Nowadays, new media prevails. As a modern means of communication, it is favored by college students for its unique and novel form. College students conduct interpersonal communication through new media more and more frequently, and the campus interpersonal relations of college students also appear some new crises because of the change of this communication mode. By analyzing the influence of new media on campus interpersonal communication and the manifestation of the new crisis of campus interpersonal relationship, this paper puts forward the countermeasures to solve the new crisis of campus interpersonal relationship of college students in combination with the moral education thinking of "cultivating people through three whole".

articleTitle: Research and Practice on the Design of Huizhou Regional Cultural Bamboo Products Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In order to make full use of bamboo resources in China and improve the modeling design level of bamboo products by integrating Huizhou regional culture, it is necessary to clarify the requirements of information and skills in the era of big data. Therefore, on the basis of understanding the development characteristics of regional culture in Huizhou, this paper analyzes how to study relevant design practice based on the concept of big data by understanding the current design direction of bamboo products in China.

articleTitle: Study on the Relationship Between Chinese Rural Residents’ Consumption and Economic Growth Based on Multiple Linear Regression Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Through to the rural residents’ consumption demand in China in recent 20 years the data changes of Chinese rural residents consumption, quantitative and qualitative analysis, analysis of influencing the deep-seated reasons of the lack of the rural residents’ consumption and points out that the rural residents inadequate effective demand, to a large extent influence the development of economic progress, analysis of China’s rural residents’ consumption structure and consumption levels of the status quo, to understand consumer demand changes and the overall trend of the rural residents’ consumption.

articleTitle: Research on the Using Behavior of Small Denomination Money in the Digital Age
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore the influence of central bank digital currency, digital payment, traditional culture, and personal factors on the user behavior of small denomination money through literature review and research results, further analyze the reasons for the use of small denomination money, give relevant suggestions, and predict the use of small denomination money in the future. Using multiple regression model and ANOVA analysis, this paper finds that the user behavior of small denomination currency has a significant positive correlation with the disadvantage cognition of digital currency, the disadvantage cognition of digital payment, and traditional culture identification. Personal factors also affect the user behavior and influencing factors of small denomination currency. Gender has a significant impact on the last time small denomination currency was used, the advantage cognition of digital payment and the disadvantage cognition of digital payment. Age has a significant impact on small denomination money, the last time when small denomination currency was used, and the influencing factors. Education level and income level have no significant impact on the user behavior and its influencing factors of small denomination money. This paper argues that although the using behavior of small denomination money is affected by the central bank's digital money and digital payment channels, it is difficult to change for a long time due to the characteristics of the user behavior itself. Therefore, the probability of a significant decline in the using rate of small denomination money is small.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Chinese People’s Recognition of Digital Currency Electronic Payment Policy
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore the degree and reasons of Chinese people’s recognition of Digital Currency Electronic Payment policy, through literature review, expert interviews and research results. Personal factors also affect the degree and reasons of DC/EP policy identification. There is a significant positive correlation between the people’s recognition of DC/EP policy (policy purpose, policy content, policy process) and the reasons for policy recognition (policy cognition, policy expectation, policy emotion, policy evaluation). Personal factors will also affect the degree of identification and the reasons for identification. The age and education level of the people have a significant impact on the degree of DC/EP policy identification and the identification reasons. The use of mobile payment devices has a significant impact on policy emotion and policy purpose.

articleTitle: Study on Development Path of Corporate Financial Management under the Background of "Internet Plus"
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the vigorous economic development and the advancement of science and technology, China has entered the Internet information era. Internet technology has promoted China's economic development. This paper analyzes the characteristics of corporate financial management under the background of "Internet plus", excavates the existing problems in the development of financial management in the emerging stage, and studies the development path of corporate financial management.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Apriori Association Algorithm in the Collection of Enterprise Financial Data
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In order to analyze and study the potential value of information in the financial information system, this article analyzes and studies the financial decisions provided by financial decision-makers. This article mainly discusses the application effect research of Apriori related algorithms in corporate financial data collection. First, it introduces the research background, research content and research significance of this system, discusses data, financial information system and online analysis and processing technology in the same industry. . Then it discusses the basic technology and methods of Apriori algorithm, especially focusing on the analysis and explanation of the algorithm's data mining technology in the financial information system. Secondly, it explains the basic principles of the financial information system, and elaborates its system structure, data organization, development and design in detail.

articleTitle: Decision and Evaluation of Ordering and Transshipment Schemes Based on Multi-objective Programming
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The decision-making and evaluation of raw material ordering and transportation schemes are common in the actual production process. This paper makes an in-depth study on the formulation of ordering and transportation schemes in the future. Firstly, this paper determines the four quantitative indicators of supplier compliance rate, stability, market reputation and raw material output-input ratio with mean square deviation to weight them, establishes TOPSIS comprehensive analysis and evaluation model, and obtains the list of the top five importance to the production guarantee of the enterprise. Then, the time series Arima prediction model is used to process the historical data of the supply volume of the top 50 suppliers and predict the supply volume corresponding to the next 24 weeks. The specific ordering and transshipment scheme is obtained by using the prediction value, the single objective function model of "minimum number of suppliers", double objective function model of "minimum number of suppliers + minimum cost", and the three objective function model of "minimum number of suppliers + minimum cost + minimum overall loss rate".

articleTitle: An Architecture and Joint Robot Group for a Long-Range Dynamic Combinatorial Flying Complex Based on Cloud Sea Computing in 5G OGCE
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Based on the fifth generation of mobile communication (5G), 5G open grid computing environment (5G OGCE), in order to adapt to "civil-military integration strategy" in region from transoceanic flight to space, and to meet the needs of air-sea integration development, a joint (connecting or docking-and-berthing) robot group (JRG) and a long-range dynamic combinatorial flying complex (combinatorial aircraft) are presented by this paper, the aim of which is to provide range extension and improve endurance of a large combat blended wing body (BWB) stealth strategic bomber (SSB). With the support of an aircraft carrier at sea, the large BWB SSB with main part of JRG and stealth unmanned aerial refueling tanker vehicle (UARTV) with joining part of JRG can be joined dynamically together to combinate a flying complex, and achieve all-weather operations in the world. This JRG has the functions similar to the external fuel tank of the aircraft and the externally mounted cruise missile, and the externally mounted aircraft acts as the external fuel tank. By using transition and channel of distributed control cloud architecture of cloud sea computing (CSC) in 5G OGCE, to command and control (C2) and drive JRG, complete the joining (docking) between SSB and UAREV in a variety of standardized movements and operations. JRG can be used to connect the wings of large BWB passenger aircrafts and stealth manned or unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), for rescue and anti-terrorism.

articleTitle: Research on Cooperative Innovation Evolution Game of Knowledge-intensive Service Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Knowledge-intensive service enterprise is an important part of innovation system. In this paper, the evolutionary game method is used to analyze the collaborative innovation process between knowledge-intensive service enterprises and client enterprises, so as to construct the evolutionary game model of the cooperation between knowledge-intensive service enterprises and client enterprises. Through the stability analysis and mathematical derivation of the dynamic equation, this paper explores the influence of government and game behavior on cooperation. The results show that creating more innovation benefits, reasonable service pricing, reducing service costs and increasing the amount of compensation for breach of contract can promote the cooperate and finally realize collaborative innovation. Finally, according to the simulation results, this paper also puts forward the dynamic mechanism, guarantee mechanism and constraint mechanism to realize the collaborative innovation between knowledge-intensive service enterprises and client enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Inheriting and Protecting Minority Furniture Based on Digital Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Minority furniture carries rich ethnic cultural connotations and is the crystallization of thousands of years of wisdom and art of the Chinese nation, with not only practical value, but also aesthetic value, cultural value, collection value and so on. Therefore, the effective inheritance and protection of minority furniture is of practical significance and far-reaching impact. This paper starts with the present situation and problems of minority furniture, quotes the research of digital technology, explained the construction of the database through an analysis of digital trends and a comparison between digital and traditional methods, and puts forward a digital implementation strategy, so as to systematically and comprehensively continue the cultural connotations of minority furniture while inheriting the skills and forms of minority furniture by digital means.

articleTitle: OTA Optimization: Evaluating Consumers’ Purchase Intention from Online Negative Review Responses Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the development of online tourism business, reserving tourism products has gradually become one of the consumption modes for consumers. However, due to the limitations of online shopping and the intangible characteristics of tourism service products, consumers rely more on the external information to make purchasing decisions. Online reviews and responses to them given by merchants, as a crucial part of the external information, especially the negative review responses, however, have not been studied in great depth. Therefore, how to mine and analyse these data, and understand the consumers’ purchase intention on different response strategies, then design personalized response strategies data to deal with different service remedies, thereby increasing the service responsiveness and competitiveness, has become imperative. Based on the Attribution theory, this study attributes the online negative review responses collected on the Online Travel Agency (OTA) platforms to three types of response strategies, then explores the effects of different negative review response strategies on consumers' purchase intention from a quantitative approach. This work contributes to the optimization of e-commerce applications and the consumer relationship management of merchants.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Significance of Foreign Investment Law in the Construction of Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In January 2020, the "Foreign Investment Law" was officially promulgated in my country.The purpose of formulating the Foreign Investment Law is to further expand opening-up.This makes foreign investment more on the track of standardization and legalization.For the construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, the "Foreign Investment Law" is even more significant.Especially in the promotion, protection and management of foreign investors, it has a very obvious effect . In the long run, it will further promote the overall economic development of our country.This article analyzes specifically from different angles, specifically analyzing the main significance of foreign investment law in the construction of it.

Author Keywords: Construction of Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area

articleTitle: Study on Influencing Factors of Shanghai Advertising Industry Agglomeration Based on Grey Relation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper constructs the index system of the influencing factors of Shanghai advertising agglomeration and makes an empirical study on the influencing factors of Shanghai advertising agglomeration by using grey relational analysis. This paper aims to analyze the internal mechanism and development logic of Shanghai advertising industry agglomeration, provide suggestions for attracting more excellent advertising enterprises and cultural talent resources to settle in, and provide a reference for the government to understand the industrial linkage and location factors.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Use And Management of Anchorage in Yangtze River Estuary Ship’s Routing Scheme
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Anchorage is an important security facility for the development of port economy. As the first station of vessels entering the Yangtze River, the anchorage safety of vessels in the Yangtze River Estuary is directly related to the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt and the construction of Shanghai international shipping center. Based on the present situation and characteristics of the use and management of the anchorage in this area, this paper analyzed the resource demand, anchorage capacity and anchorage safety, analyzed the relationship among them. It is found that there are still many defects in the management regulations, dangerous cargo vessels, the traffic flow in the vicinity of the anchorage and the construction of emergency forces in the anchorage area of the Yangtze River Estuary, and corresponding suggestions are put forward.

Author Keywords: anchorage in the Yangtze River Estuary

articleTitle: The Corporate Board Structure, Ownership Retention and IPO Underpricing: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This article uses all IPO companies in China from 2010 to 2019 as a sample to study the influence of board structure and ownership retention on IPO underpricing. The results show that the board’s senior management’s shareholding ratio, the number of board members, and the number of institutional shareholdings can reduce IPO underpricing. Independent directors and female directors have no influence on IPO underpricing. In addition, the time of company establishment, ROA, and gross profit can attract investors to buy shares of listed companies.

articleTitle: Corpus-Based Research on the Use of Foreign Language Chunks
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: As a prefabricated or semi-prefabricated unit of meaning between vocabulary and grammar, lexical blocks can be stored in the corpus directly for users without needing to be processed and analyzed again. Nowadays, a lot of interpreting research has show that lexical chunks and interpretation of efficiency, accuracy and fluency are directly related, so this article, therefore, in understanding the current corpus and its piece of research, on the basis of a clear opportunity to foreign language chunk application characteristics of corpus, and outline of CET band four words, for example analysis to establish the feasibility of chunk table.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Cultural Creative Intelligent Products in Liaoning Province
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: More and more modern technology has been applied to the traditional cultural creative industry, which has enhanced the technicality and novelty of traditional cultural products. The integration of culture and modern technology is profoundly changing the way people live and learn. Liaoning new formats, to develop cultural industry is not only a "restructuring, livelihood" major step, is the revitalization of Liaoning economy important economic engine, this paper deeply analysis the Liaoning province regional cultural industry development present situation and innovation development pattern of cultural products, to explore suitable for the condition of culture industry in Liaoning province traditional cultural products of intelligent and marketization process. And explore the effect of the intellectualization of traditional cultural products. Through these studies, it can provide important enlightenment for the intellectualization of traditional cultural products in Liaoning Province, showing that the integration of new technology, especially information technology and traditional cultural and creative industry is not only conducive to the transformation of traditional cultural and creative industry, forming new business forms and models, but also conducive to promoting the upgrading and intelligent transformation of related industries.

articleTitle: Research on the Use Intention of English Learning APP Among College Students
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Based on the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) to study the factors that influence the intention to use English learning APP. Refer to many research results in the research on consumer behavior influencing factors, combined with the interview method to understand user experience and other information, build an English learning APP use intention influence model based on the technology acceptance model, put forward corresponding hypotheses and design questionnaires to obtain data Analyze consumers' intentions and influencing factors, use SPSS software to carry out data analysis, verify the hypotheses of influencing factors, analyze the problems existing in the English learning APP, provide guidance for its product and content improvement, and provide it with reference Suggestions for improvement to improve product competitiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Public Opinion Forecast of Public Policy Based on Big Data Media
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Although the rapid development of information technology has changed the living and working mode of residents, it has also brought new challenges to the management of social public affairs. Especially for online public opinion, with the enhancement of the democratic awareness of the masses, Internet users can find more hidden information when participating in the implementation of existing policies. Therefore, on the basis of understanding the concept of public policy forecasting, this paper analyzes the development situation of the current policy public opinion inclination and how to construct a public policy forecasting model based on big data media.

articleTitle: End-To-End Algorithm Optimization and Implementation Based on Speech Translation
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Speech translation is the process of automatically translating the commands from the speech signals of the source language into the text of the specified language by using machine completion instructions. The main operation method now is to associate speech recognition with machine translation. Because speech recognition, machine translation and speech translation are essentially the transformation from one sequence to another, and the end-to-end architecture can also be applied to speech recognition and machine translation, the researchers studied end-to-end speech translation. Because the integration of speech recognition and machine translation into one model modeling makes the input sequence and output sequence more difficult and cumbersome, it is necessary to carry out more difficult training on the model and analyze more training data. On this basis, this paper studies end-to-end speech translation and related training methods respectively.

articleTitle: The Returns to Innovation of Chinese Firms : Based on Empirical Evidence from the "China Manufacturing Enterprises Survey"
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the context of the explosive growth in the scale of innovation in China, the increase in innovation yield is becoming increasingly important for long-term economic growth and productivity improvement. Based on a systematic review of existing literature, this paper, from the perspective of "innovation input-innovation output-innovation effect", conducts a multi-dimensional empirical test on the direct return rate and economic return rate of Chinese enterprises’ innovation at the present stage. Based on the data of the 2018 "China Manufacturing Enterprises Survey", empirical research finds that the low efficiency of innovation input and the low transformational capacity are the important reasons for the low direct return on innovation. The low quality of innovation has become an important reason to restrict the improvement of innovation economic returns.

articleTitle: Power Grid Disaster Loss Information Fusion Analysis and Prediction Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: After the natural disaster attacks the power grid, a large number of alarm information will flow into the control center, especially when the power grid has complex faults or the automatic device acts abnormally. Because there are some uncertain factors in protection, circuit breaker misoperation, rejection and channel reasons, a kind of disaster assessment method that can realize uncertain information is of great significance. Although the traditional evaluation algorithm based on rough set can deal with uncertain information, it can only deal with discrete data effectively. In practice, there are continuous data and most of them are fuzzy, and the boundary between concepts is not very clear. Fuzzy set can overcome this disadvantage. This paper creatively proposes a method based on intuitionistic fuzzy rough set to evaluate power grid disasters timely and accurately. In the evaluation, attribute filtering and data cleaning are used to reduce the redundancy of disaster attributes; Through value filtering, the evaluation rules are extracted, the disaster level is determined through matching, and adjusted and updated with the development of the situation, so as to provide a scientific basis for emergency decision-making.

articleTitle: Forecasting Industrial Futures Index Based On Fuzzy Set Time Series
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The futures market is a complex and unstable market with uncertain factors, which has the characteristics of nonlinear dynamic change. Many factors, including political, social, macroeconomic trends and investor psychology, can cause futures prices to change. In view of some characteristics of futures market, based on the fuzzy set theory, we uses the first-order fuzzy time series model to forecast China's industrial futures index. In this paper, the algorithm and steps of fuzzy time series prediction model are explained in detail. The prediction results show that the fuzzy time series model can be used to predict the price index of industrial futures in the short term with high precision, which proves that the research method and the model established in this paper are practical and effective.

articleTitle: Research on Feature and Architecture Design of AI Firewall
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper analyzes the current network security environment and the shortcomings of firewall products in the current network environment, and expounds the benefits that can be brought by the application of AI technology in threat detection.
