Then, the paper analyzes the advantages of AI firewall and expounds the characteristics that AI firewall can build learning models and realize the independent evolution of threat detection capability. Finally, the intelligent defense system and logical architecture of AI firewall are designed. The intelligent defense system has three components, including cloud intelligence, security center and firewall. The logical architecture has six layers of architecture, including hardware layer, data layer, algorithm layer, detection layer, analysis layer and interaction layer. These designs provide some reference for the design and development of AI firewall.

articleTitle: Research on Hospital Audit Risk Prediction Model Based on Big Data Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Based on the understanding of the development background of big data information fusion, according to the analysis of the current hospital operation management mechanism, how to build a hospital audit risk prediction model based on big data information fusion, and take stroke phenomenon as an example for case analysis.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Influence of Social Capital on Agricultural Enterprise Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Based on the understanding of the research projects related to social capital and enterprise performance in recent years, this paper combines the positive impact of social capital on technological innovation of agricultural enterprises, and analyzes the impact of social capital on the performance of agricultural enterprises by building a theoretical model.

articleTitle: Research on Virtual Clothing Design Detection Algorithm Based on Huizhou Traditional Clothing Culture
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: As a Chinese city with unique historical and cultural heritage, Huizhou has shown great attraction and influence both on the world stage and in people's eyes. Therefore, on the basis of understanding the current cultural characteristics of Huizhou traditional clothing and according to the inheritance of traditional clothing culture in the current clothing market, this paper analyzes how to construct virtual clothing design detection algorithm based on the traditional clothing culture of Huizhou.

articleTitle: Game Analysis of Government and Enterprise in Green Supply Chain Management of Agricultural Products
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper uses a game model to study the optimal decision-making results of pure and mixed strategies between the government and enterprises in the management of agricultural green supply chain. The results show that only by continuously improving the benefits of green supply chain management of agricultural products and reducing its costs can companies participate in the green road, and the government can gradually pass the implementation of subsidies without inspection. Based on the above analysis, it provides relevant countermeasures and suggestions for the supply chain management of agricultural products.

articleTitle: Research on Cultural Network Resources and Tourism Financing in Yangtze River Delta Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Under the background of rapid social and economic development, tourism occupies a higher and higher position in the national construction and development. In this trend, according to their own development needs, the implementation of financing based on carbon sink trading is the focus of the development of enterprises in all countries at this stage. Based on the understanding of cultural network resources and industry development trend in the Yangtze River Delta at the present stage, this paper studies how to promote effective tourism financing based on big data according to the analysis of carbon sink financing mode.

articleTitle: Research on the Replacement Rate of Pension
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: According to the provisions of the present institution endowment insurance policy, this paper establishes a model for calculating the replacement rate of pension insurance for the employee of the government institutions, who according with formulary capture to expend fixed number of year and retiring after the implementation of the new policy to retire. It can not only measure the pension replacement rate for the "someone joins in the beginning", but also can for the "someone joins in the Intermediate stage ". The results show that the pension replacement rate is positively related to the actual payment period, and is negatively related to the payment of wages. As long as the one-year deposit rate to remain at around 2.5% level, can achieve a smooth transition, and to maintain a slight upward trend of pension replacement rate. At the same time, for those who have paid for 15 to 35 years, the pension replacement rate will increase from 40% to about 93%.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Multimodal Video Retrieval System
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the application of deep learning in various fields, it replaces the extraction of video by manual design. Through the analysis and research of modal video retrieval methods, this paper aims to use text, image or video to carry out different ways of video retrieval through multi-modal video retrieval, and strive to meet the needs of different scenes, different users of video retrieval, and maximize the accuracy and effectiveness of video retrieval. This paper designs and implements a deep learning-based multimodal video retrieval system based on Windows. The system is based on the design concept of program modularization, using MySQL as the database and PyQT4 as the development tool of system interface. It mainly realizes three functional modules of video retrieval based on text, video retrieval based on image and video retrieval based on video segment.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning In The Diagnosis of Faulty Electrical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Electricity is closely related to human life, to say the least, in modern society, countries and cities without electricity can be paralyzed. National defense, transportation, daily life and so on are inseparable from electricity. Electrical energy is the most basic energy in modern society, and people are almost always in the moment. Electric cookers for cooking need electricity, refrigerators, TVS, air conditioners, computers and fans need electricity, as well as electric lights that give us light in the dark night. Therefore, a power failure in daily life is just like the sky falling down, which is extremely painful. Adults can’t see the news; the elderly can’t use high-tech to cook the rice; even children can’t play the computer. Electricity is an indispensable electrical appliance in people’s daily life and work. Once faulty electrical equipment is not diagnosed and resolved effectively, it will seriously affect people’s normal life and work. So it is very important to do a good job in the diagnosis of faulty electrical equipment. The image retrieval method based on deep learning is an effective fault diagnosis technology. Based on this, the relevant electrical fault diagnosis department should deeply explore the effective application methods of deep learning in the diagnosis of faulty electrical equipment, so as to give full play to the value of image retrieval and improve the diagnosis of faulty electrical equipment.

articleTitle: The application value of big data in China’s social work
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In recent years, with the arrival of the era of big data, big data involves a wide range of issues. This paper mainly analyzes the concept of big data and the literature involved. This paper analyzes and studies the impact of theoretical knowledge on big data in science and technology, philosophy, sociology and other disciplines. At the same time, the problems involved in the learning process, professional theoretical knowledge, as well as the topic involved in a deep level of research, at the same time to realize the integration and unification of theoretical knowledge in multiple fields. This paper mainly analyzes and studies the development situation of big data from the perspective of historical development, and analyzes and studies the essence of big data from the perspective of science and technology. If hypothesis theory of the social effects of the big data exist for the premise, in grasping the thinking logic, on the basis of change and transformation of the industrial development from such aspects as technology, economy and society were analyzed, and according to the data driving mechanism and path of development, combined with the relationship between science and technology, society, the big data and various industries for the society and benefit analysis of the impact of the study.

articleTitle: The Application of Data Mining Technology in Crime Prediction Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Data mining technology, as the basic content of research and development in the field of artificial intelligence, has been actively applied in many industries. On the basis of understanding the content of data mining technology, this paper analyzes how to make crime prediction according to the current social development situation, and constructs a perfect comprehensive model of crime analysis.

articleTitle: Institutional Investors Holding, Auditor Choice and Earnings Management
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: From the external governance perspective, the paper studies institutional investors participate in the governance of the company and reduce the company’s earnings management. The result shows that, the firms are more likely to employ high- quality audit firms and have lower earnings management when institutional investors’ holdings are big. The result indicates that institutional investors could influence the choice of auditors which is the external governance mechanisms to reduce the company’s earnings management, and to obtain high-quality accounting reports.

articleTitle: The Development of Vocal Music Education in China After 1980
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the continuous development of China’s economic globalization, the influx of various foreign ideas, more and more forms of social culture emerge. Influenced by this multiculturalism, China’s vocal music education in universities has some change, and also has encountered new attempt and challenges.

articleTitle: The Dynamic Evolution Analysis of Regional Development Differences of High-tech Industries : —Based on China's data from 1997 to 2019
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper uses Theil index model to measure the dynamic evolution of regional difference in the development of high-tech industries in China from 1997 to 2019. The results show that the overall regional difference of China's high-tech industry development has experienced a process of first rising and then declining with the boundaries of 2003. Before 2003, the regional development was not balanced and the overall regional difference was non-convergence. After 2003, the overall regional difference narrowed year by year, showing a trend of gradual balanced development. In the same period, the inter-regional differences also experienced a process of first rising and then declining, while the intra-regional differences showed a general downward trend. From the contribution degree to the total difference, the inter-regional difference occupies the main contribution. In addition, some data show that some intra-regional differences in the four major regions are negative, which indicates that the development of these provinces is relatively slow.

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of Box Office: A Case Study of the Top 100 Films in the Chinese Box Office in 2019
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of film industry in China, the domestic industry chain has been continuously improved in recent years. However, the film industry is still of high risk with frequent investment losses, insufficient growth of potential viewers in urban cinemas, and an unclear performance of domestic films among the global film market. Through establishing a multiple linear regression model, which takes the top 100 films in the box office list in 2019 as research objects, we explore variables which have a significant impact on the box office and use one-way ANOVA to analyze whether film theme is one of the factors affecting the box office. The following conclusions are obtained in this paper: (1) Score, number of potential audience, schedule and place of origin all have a significant impact on the box office. (2) The average box office of the films released in popular schedule is higher than that in the non-popular schedule. The average box office of the films produced in China is higher than that in other countries. (3) Among various themes of films, science fiction films are more popular with consumers. (4)There is a conformity effect among consumers in China’s film market in 2019. Our results have shed light on the real situation of China's film market in 2019 and provided some reference for looking for opportunities to obtain high box office.

articleTitle: Real-Time Detection and Analysis System for Tea Leafhopper
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The tea leafhopper is the most common and harmful pest in a tea garden. The traditional automatic pest detection and counting method is low in accuracy and efficiency. Therefore, accurate and real-time detection of the tea leafhopper is of great significance for predicting insect situation. To this end, a set of real-time detection and analysis equipment was designed to solve the problem of the tea leafhopper. First, remote image acquisition equipment was used to collect images, which were uploaded to the cloud server for detection. Afterward, the results of detection and tea leafhopper analysis were displayed on the web. The results reveal that the designed system is available for detection using images of 4000*3000 pixels within 8s. Test set consists of 25,000 independent images, Recall is 0.9 and the number of FP is only 90. The experimental results demonstrate that the system meets the requirements for real-time (detecting pests in less than 10 s is defined as real-time) and accurate detection of tea leafhoppers.

articleTitle: Short Term Traffic Flow Prediction Method based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of urbanization, the number of urban motor vehicles is rising rapidly, and the contradiction between supply and demand of urban traffic is increasingly tense. Nowadays, one of the effective ways to solve traffic problems is to build intelligent transportation system. As the key technology of this intelligent system, traffic prediction is the premise and key of traffic guidance and control. In the face of the above development, a short- term traffic flow prediction method based on fuzzy clustering algorithm is proposed. With the help of the basic characteristic parameters of traffic flow, the short-term traffic flow data are obtained and preprocessed. On this basis, the short-term traffic flow prediction evaluation index is defined, and the "distance" measurement conditions for the two criteria are established by publishing traffic information service, so as to realize the smooth application of the short-term traffic flow prediction method based on fuzzy clustering algorithm. The experimental results show that, with the support of fuzzy clustering algorithm, the accuracy of artificial short-term traffic flow prediction is greatly improved. Compared with the quadratic exponential smoothing method, this new prediction method has greater feasibility and application value.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis of Rational and Emotional Appeal Design Strategies in Short Video Advertising
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Through rational appeals and emotional appeals, advertising affects audiences’ preferences and purchase behaviors for products. Short video advertisements have strong advantages in information dissemination in the mobile internet environment. This paper uses empirical methods to explore the design strategies and methods of consumer electronic product advertisements. This paper selects smartphones as the research object and analyzes the impact of rational and emotional appeals in video advertisements on people through the semantic difference method. This research uses EEG physiological measurement indicators and the 7- Likert scale to obtain attention level and emotional evaluation, and then analyzes how to obtain the audience’s attention in a short period of time, and how rational and emotional appeals affect the audience's preference and desire to buy. In the end, some smartphone short video advertisement design strategies are proposed for reference when designing advertisements, whether the goal is establishing an impression or expanding the market.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Influence Mechanism of RMB Internationalization on China’s OFDI : Based on the “The Belt and Road Country Panel Data” Model
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Starting with The B&R countries, this study gathers the macro annual data of 46 economies along the Belt and Road between 2011 and 2019. Using panel data model, this paper empirically studies the influence mechanism of RMB internationalization on China’s OFDI. The results show that the level of RMB internationalization has a positive effect on the stock of China’s OFDI to "The Belt and Road" countries. China’s import and export trade with host countries significantly contributed to the growth of OFDI. The economic development level of the host country has a significant positive effect on OFDI of Chinese enterprises, while the economic distance between China and the host country and the exchange rate fluctuation of the host country have a negative effect on OFDI. Therefore, this paper puts forward the following suggestions: China should continue to promote and deepen the "The Belt and Road" construction, promote the internationalization of RMB and encourage enterprises to invest directly in the emerging markets along the "The Belt and Road". With the "The Belt and Road" as the pilot project, China will radiate to the outside world to enhance China’s economic strength and the international discourse power of its currency. The role of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank and the Silk Road Fund should be brought into full play, and financial infrastructure should be improved.

articleTitle: Is Blind Box a Toy or an Investment
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore blind box purchasing behavior, purchase causes, influencing factors, and personal factors through literature review, expert interviews, and research results. It also studies purchasing experience, consumption amount, consumption causes, investment causes, advantage cognition, and disadvantage cognition. Personal factors also affect blind box purchasing behavior and influencing factors.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Innovation Driving Ability in Western China : Taking the 12 western provinces as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper constructs a comprehensive evaluation index system of innovation level for the western China based on the connotation of innovative development in the new era and the characteristics of innovative development in the western China of China. It collects the corresponding index data of 12 western provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities are inclusive) from 2014 to 2018, and further evaluates the regional innovation level of each western province by method of weighted TOPSIS. The results show that different regions in western China take on differentiated level in innovation-driven development. In addition, Sichuan, Shaanxi and Chongqing rank high in regional innovation capability in the western China.

Author Keywords: Index system of scientific and technological innovation

articleTitle: Analysis of Stackelberg Game in Central bank Digital Currencies and Digital Payment Platform - Case Study of Chinese Digital Currency
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The issuance and promotion of central bank digital currency make it feasible to replace the digital payment channels dominated by private companies, which are currently dominant in the mobile payment market. The two payment methods are bound to compete fiercely in the future payment market. Based on the antecedents and unknowns of digital RMB issuance, this study discusses the game competition between digital RMB and third party payment and researches the trend in the development of the mobile payment market in the future and the best coping strategies for both sides. Based on Metcalfe’s law and CAPM model, this study analyzes the game strategy and equilibrium result between digital RMB and third party payment by establishing the Stackelberg master-slave game model from the point of view of both sides occupying the market to obtain maximum income. Moreover, use Matlab2018a to simulate the profit difference when two sides have a different number of users. The study proves that the digital RMB can not dominate the mobile payment market competing with the third party payment unless the government vigorously promotes the digital RMB in the short-run game. The Nash equilibrium in the game is cooperation. Furthermore, the profits are restricted by the size of the user for both sides.

articleTitle: Study of China’s OFDI Efficiency on RCEP Member Countries-Based on DEA-Malmqiust Index
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: As RECP (Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement) was signed smoothly, China's investment efficiency on RECP member countries has drawn much attention. According to the panel data of China's direct investment in 14 RECP member countries from 2011 to 2019, this essay uses the DEA-Malmquist index model to conduct a comprehensive assessment of investment efficiency along with its changes. The study reveals that the efficiency of China’s investment in other member states generally shows an upward trend, and the investment efficiency of different countries varies. China’s investment efficiency on 11 countries has shown an upward trend while the remaining three countries shows a downward trend. The efficiency of OFDI (Outward Foreign Direct Investment) is affected by the host country’s economic development, market size, the political relationship between China and the host country, economic and trade relations and other factors. Meanwhile, during the assessment period, China's investment efficiency on the 14 RECP member countries shows a fluctuating upward trend (up by 3%). In the past three years, comprehensive technical efficiency has been the main factor restricting the progress of efficiency. To promote the efficient and sustainable development of Chinese investment in RECP member countries, this paper provides relevant suggestions.

articleTitle: The Study on Consumer Behavior of Online Luxury Goods
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Due to the rapid development of science and technology in China, online luxury consumption behavior has gradually become a new trend, and more and more people begin to consume online luxury goods. The purpose of this paper is to use a multiple regression model and ANOVA analysis to explore consumer behavior and influencing factors of online luxury consumption. The results show that the online luxury purchase experience has a significant positive correlation with advantages cognition, disadvantages cognition of online luxury consumption, and the effect of star live broadcast for the promotion of luxury goods. The consumption amount was significantly positively correlated with advantages cognition, disadvantages cognition, and star live broadcast effect. Personal factors also affect online luxury purchase behavior and influencing factors. Gender has a significant impact on the reasons for the online consumption of luxury goods. Age has a significant impact on the sum of consumption of online luxury goods, consumption reasons, and the perception of disadvantages. Educational background has a significant impact on the sum of consumption of online luxury goods. Monthly income has a significant impact on the sum of consumption of online luxury goods and the perception of disadvantages, and the urbanization of residence has a significant impact on the sum of consumption of online luxury goods.

articleTitle: The Consumption Behaviour of Short Video Users and Its Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The purpose of the article discusses the consumption behaviour, influencing factors and personal factors of short video users through literature review, expert interviews and research results. Among the consumption behaviour, it studies herd mentality, blind mentality, impulsive mentality and experiential consumption. Among the influencing factors, it studies advertisements, live commerce, community effects and consumption reasons. At the same time, it also studies the influence of personal factors on short video users' consumption behaviour. Whether short video users consume in short video platform and how much does a person cost has a significant positive correlation with advertisements, live commerce, the community effects and consumption reasons; Incomes in personal factors have a positive significant influence on monthly cost; The consumption reasons in short video platforms, consuming in short video platform (TikTok), consuming in short video platform (Kwai) and advertisements on consumption behaviour significantly affect whether short video users consume. The consumption reasons and the geographic location significantly affect the monthly cost of short video users.

articleTitle: Green Bond Financing Development Research in China
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In order to promote economic development, China has paid a high environmental price. Although this measure has led to economic development, it has caused irreparable damage to the environment. Green and sustainable development has become the theme of the development of today's times. as an important force in green finance, green bonds are based on environmental protection and sustainable economic and social development. it is an important link to promote the establishment of a green financial system in an all-round way in the 13th five-year Plan, and it also represents the new development direction of the world financial industry. Based on the above background, first of all, the definition of green bonds and combined with relevant theories, through the case analysis, ratio analysis and other methods to conduct in-depth research. Secondly, it analyzes the issuance of domestic green bonds and finds out its shortcomings. Finally, through the analysis of the emergence stage of China's green bond financing related suggestions, including the issuer of the management of funds raised, government departments how to introduce relevant policy incentives, as well as regulatory supervision and other appropriate suggestions. So that green bonds can get a healthy development in our country, at the same time, it can provide relevant reference for other enterprises to carry out green bond financing.

articleTitle: Research on Airport Passenger Service Quality Evaluation System Based on Four Characteristics Airport Development Concept
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In order to comply with the trend of civil aviation development in the new era and comprehensively promote the construction of civil aviation power, CAAC proposed to build the airport that centered on four characteristics of "safe, green, smart and humanistic" in 2020, which put forward higher requirements for the airport passenger service level. This paper aims at integrating four characteristics airport development concept into the airport passenger service, constructing quality evaluation index system, adopting AHP method to confirm the index weight and grey clustering method to evaluate the service quality of Nanchang Changbei international airport. The result indicates that airport traffic is the weak link in the airport passenger service quality, which points out the direction for promoting the development of four characteristics airport passenger service quality.

articleTitle: Board independence, financing constraints and stock price volatility: Empirical evidence from A-share listed companies in Shanghai and Shenzhen
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This article takes 2018 Shanghai and Shenzhen A- share listed companies as the object, and specifically examines the influence of the independence of the board of directors and financing constraints on the fluctuation of corporate stock prices. Through empirical research, we find that financing constraints are negatively correlated with stock price volatility. The financing constraint coefficient increases by 1%, and the stock price volatility decreases by 9.88%. The greater the independence of the board of directors, the greater the impact of financing constraints on stock price volatility. The independence of the board of directors increased by 1%, and the financing constraint coefficient’s ability to restrain stock price fluctuations increased by about 28.60%. Furthermore, this paper conducts a robustness test from the three dimensions of ownership, firm size, and firm age, and verifies that the extreme tail effect of stock price collapse risk does not exist in each quantile. Based on the analysis mentioned above, this article puts forward relevant policy recommendations from the two perspectives of board independence and financing constraints.

articleTitle: Research on the Efficiency of Capital Utilization of Insurance Asset Management Companies in China : based on the three-stage DEA model
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the asset scale of insurance industry, the problem, how to use funds more efficiently to improve efficiency needs to be solved urgently. Based on the three-stage DEA model, this paper measures the capital utilization of 10 insurance asset management companies in China from 2013 to 2018. The empirical results show that the overall capital utilization efficiency of insurance asset management companies in China is relatively low. According to the problems of low efficiency and scale adjustment, it is suggested that optimizing investment, such as improving investment ability, expanding business scale, introducing and cultivating talents, in order to form a modern investment philosophy and promote the efficiency of capital utilization.

articleTitle: Measurement and Analysis of Green Total Factor Productivity in Yangtze River Economic Belt-Based on DEA-Malmquist Index Method
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper used the panel data of 11 cities along the Yangtze River Economic Belt from 2010 to 2016 to figure out the GTFP index of the Yangtze Economic Zone through the DEA-Malmquist index method. It found was found that: the overall GTFP of the Yangtze Economic Zone shows continuous growth and relies on technological progress; the growth rates of GTFP are different at different part of the Yangtze Economic Zone during the period of study, with negative growth in the lower parts of Yangtze River and positive growth in the middle and upper parts of Yangtze River; cites in this area has same characteristics of GTFP while has their own features respectively, and technological progress is the main driving force for GTFP growth.

articleTitle: Quality Analysis of Industrial Sustainable Development in Hubei Province under New Development Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Under the new development paradigm of the 14th Five-Year Plan, it is of great significance to further promote the sustainable development of industry and promote the comprehensive green and low-carbon transformation of industrial enterprises to improve their quality and efficiency. As a traditional industrial province in China, Hubei Province has some problems such as low utilization rate of resources, high pollution and low utilization rate of scientific and technological achievements. Based on an in-depth analysis of industrial development in Hubei Province from 2008 to 2019, this paper established an index system of industrial input and output, and applied DEA model to discuss the quality of industrial sustainable development in Hubei Province. The results showed that the industrial development in some years had a low quality with redundant input and insufficient output, and the scale efficiency could be further improved. Finally, from the perspective of government macroeconomic control and driving force of industrial enterprises, this paper put forward multi-level suggestions on how to improve the quality of industrial sustainable development in Hubei Province.

articleTitle: Does the Management Tone Information Convey the Level of Firm Innovation? : Evidence from Earnings Communication Conferences of GEM Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Based on the text analysis of the 2010-2017 performance briefings of non-financial companies on China Growth Enterprise Market, this paper studies the relationship between management tone and corporate innovation. The conclusion of the study is that there is no significant relationship between the positive tone of management and corporate innovation, which confirms that in our high-context society, people’s language preference is to say good things and cannot convey true information. The more negative the tone of management, the lower the level of corporate innovation. However, the more positive the net tone of management, the higher the level of corporate innovation, which indicates that the tone information answered by management can convey the level of corporate innovation to a certain extent. Further analysis found that, the higher the quality of accounting information, the more significant the relationship between management tone and corporate innovation. This conclusion provides theoretical support and empirical evidence for regulators to strengthen the management tone behavior of management performance briefings, to identify innovative behaviors of listed companies for investors, and to improve the capital market information environment.

articleTitle: Study on the Risk Contagion Effect between Chinese and American Financial Markets Based on BEKK-GARCH Model
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the significant increase of uncertainties facing the global economy, systemic risks in China and international financial markets occur frequently, seriously restricting the stable development of financial markets and the smooth operation of the economy. In the context of economic globalization and the integration of market economy, the increased correlation between markets leads to the enhancement of risk resonance effect, which leads to the contagion of risks among different markets, among which China is particularly affected by the fluctuation effect of American market risks. In view of this, this paper uses the BEKK-GARCH (1,1) model to explore the risk contagion effect between China and the United States during the period of January 2, 2001 solstice and March 19, 2021. The results show that, first, in the full sample interval, there is a two-way volatility spillover effect between the Chinese market and the American market and there is a Granger causality. The degree of volatility spillover from American to China is more significant. Second, in the four crisis intervals, the volatility spillover effects of China and the US show some characteristics different from those of the full sample interval. During the European debt crisis, there was a positive volatility spillover effect between the two markets, and the spillover degree of systemic risks in China’s market to the US market was more significant. During COVID-19, the US market risks had negative volatility spillover to the Chinese market. Third, both the Chinese and American markets are affected by their own fluctuations in the early stage with relatively large impacts and short duration, while the impact of the US on China lasts for about 7 periods.

articleTitle: The Impacts of Food Safety Knowledge and Attitude on Food Handling Behaviors: A Field Research on Household Refrigerator Use
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Family food safety incidents occur frequently in our country, and food storage, as an important part to ensure family food safety, has a significant impact on family foodborne diseases. In order to understand the current situation of household food safety, learn the residents’ misunderstandings and inappropriate refrigerator use behavior and analyze the main factors affecting the degree of specification of refrigerator use, based on the field survey data of 476 households in Zhejiang, this paper empirically analyzes household refrigerator use behavior, and identifies high- risk groups and risk behaviors and their influencing factors. The results show that the residents’ food safety knowledge has a positive effect on their refrigerator use behaviors directly, and it also takes effect by influencing their attitudes but there is individual heterogeneity. Therefore, the author argues that the relevant departments attach importance to the family food safety risks. They are expected to promote citizens’ food safety awareness and cultivate their habit of using the refrigerator in a standard way by disseminating food safety knowledge to them. They should comprehensively consider factors such as the regional economy, social and cultural environment, and use the "government-family" mode to ensure family food safety.

Author Keywords: Risk Behavior in Home Food Processing

articleTitle: Text Mining Applied in Evolution of Q&A Platforms users’ Information Demand on Tourism in COVID-19 Normalization
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to study the changing trend of Chinese Internet users' attitude towards tourism under the influence of COVID-19, and to explore the value of tourism development and change in the stage of normalization of COVID-19. This research obtained 870,000 user comments by crawler on the topic of "tourism" from Zhihu, China's largest online Q&A community, and classified 12 first-level topics by exploring the topics in user comments based on LDA model. In addition, this research utilized the SnowNLP model to make emotion analysis on each comment, and compared the trend of users' attention as well as emotion on tourism-related topics in months from 2019 to 2020. It is found that the attention to tourism in online communities has increased due to COVID-19; the fluctuation of attention to each tourism-related topic is closely related to the progress of COVID-19 and the promulgation of related policies. Users' emotion tendency and attention fluctuation in each topic show a high degree of consistency. Based on this, this paper puts forward suggestions including stabilizing the tourism industry structure and vigorously developing online tourism and IP consumption.

articleTitle: Impacts of Belt and Road Initiative on China’s Foreign Trade Costs
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Bilateral trade costs have become a chief barrier to global economic integration, with international trade growing enormously in the past few decades. However, Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) in full swing brings numerous opportunities and challenges to China’s international trade, which therefore has impacts on China’s trade costs. Using annual panel data of trade and economy from 1998 to 2016, this paper first measures the bilateral trade costs between China and 128 countries, and then analyzes the impacts of BRI on bilateral trade costs between China and B&R countries. B&R and non- B&R countries get the decreased trade costs together over time. Furthermore, B&R countries possess the smaller trade costs than non-B&R countries with China simultaneously, the bilateral trade costs between China and Southeast Asia are the smallest in B&R region. Strong negative impacts are obvious in the advance of BRI on bilateral trade costs between China and B&R countries, and the level of these impacts is more significant in 2014 than the rest years. Moreover, 21st-Century Maritime Silk Road countries reflect stronger impacts than The Silk Road Economic Belt countries on China’s bilateral trade costs.

articleTitle: How Does Technology Diversification Strategy Affect Corporate Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This article constructed a general framework for technology diversification strategy, capital structure and financial performance by drawing on the research paradigm of strategic management, and distinguishing technology diversification into related technology diversification and non-related technology diversification, taking 2010-2019 listed manufacturing companies as research Object, analyzed the impact of technology diversification strategy of my country's listed manufacturing companies on capital structure and corporate performance.

articleTitle: A Study on the Space-time Evolution of Agricultural Productivity in the Yangtze River Economic Belt : An Empirical analysis based on three-stage DEA model
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Panel Data of each province from 2010 to 2019 were selected to conduct an empirical analysis of agricultural production efficiency in the Yangtze River Economic Belt based on a three-stage DEA model. The results show that environmental variables and random disturbances have significant effects on agricultural production efficiency; agricultural production efficiency in the middle reaches of the Yangtze River is higher than that in the upper reaches and downstream regions, showing certain regional characteristics; in general, the allocation of agricultural production resources in the Yangtze River Economic Belt is relatively reasonable; the current situation and causes of agricultural production efficiency are inconsistent among provinces and cities, and targeted agricultural reforms should be carried out closely with their own reality.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Relationship between Diversified M&A Types and Long-term Performance of Tourism Enterprises Based on Environmental Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the improvement of the capital market, the merger and acquisition activities of enterprises gradually show the characteristics of standardization and marketization. According to the dynamic environment, the relationship between enterprise diversification and its performance is one of the core research topics of enterprise strategic management. Dynamic capabilities and their dimension capabilities are positively correlated with financial performance and non-financial performance of enterprises, and environmental dynamics has a moderating effect on the relationship between dynamic capabilities and non-financial performance of enterprises. An empirical study on the relationship between environmental dynamics and corporate performance aims to examine the relationship between the capital structure of listed companies and corporate performance in a transitional economy with environmental dynamics as the main feature in China. And because of the particularity of China’s market environment, traditional research methods can not measure the diversified M&A performance of enterprises. Therefore, the relationship between diversified M&A types and long-term performance of tourism enterprises using environmental dynamics is studied.

articleTitle: Analysis of The Status Quo and Problems of Convertible Bond Financing of Listed Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Convertible bonds have become an important refinancing method for listed companies because they can be converted into ordinary stocks at specific time and conditions, with low financing costs, large financing scale, and lighter performance pressure for issuing companies[1]. However, listed companies will have some problems when using convertible bonds to raise funds. Therefore, it is necessary to analyze the size of the convertible bond market and the financing incentives and financing efficiency of listed companies based on the data of convertible bond financing of listed companies in China. This paper uses literature research method, typical case study method and data analysis method to analyze the current situation of convertible bond financing of listed companies in China from four aspects: the issue of convertible bonds, the distribution of bond issuers, the credit rating and the design of convertible bonds. The analysis will focus on the small scale of the convertible bond market at the current stage, the lack of accelerated expansion of the convertible bond market, the uneven distribution of the convertible bond industry, the low short-term financing efficiency, the convertible bond stocks and the debt imbalance. According to the internal and external aspects of the listed companies, I put forward the optimization suggestions for constructing a good development environment for convertible debt financing and correctly guiding the issuers of convertible bonds.

articleTitle: Analyzing Factors Driving Cross-border RMB Settlement based on Panel Data of 65 Countries via Heckman Two-step and Panel Regression Models
publicationTitle: 2021 5th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In this paper, the Heckman two-step and panel regression models are applied to analyze panel data of cross-border receipts and payments of RMB in 65 countries along the "Belt and Road" from 2013 to 2018, with a view of researching the driving factors of cross-border RMB settlement. The recent years have witnessed rapid growth of cross-border RMB receipts and payments, which plays a vital role in bilateral trade and significantly accelerated the process of RMB internationalization. The results of this study show that signing of currency swap and free trade agreements and the GDP of a country significantly promotes its utilization of RMB as the currency for receipts and payments of cross-border trade activities. Further, countries that are geographically closer to China are more likely to use RMB as the settlement currency. However, the influence of a factor varies across countries from different regions along the "Belt and Road". For example, China’s GDP has different effects on RMB settlement in East Europe and West Asia, indicating that RMB internationalization should be promoted based on regional characteristics.
